methodology.localeFiles: All checked-in public/locales/<language>/*.json files; one file per language and filename stem namespace.
methodology.primitiveLeaves: Recursive JSON traversal: each string/number/boolean/null counts as one leaf; object and array containers do not.
methodology.rawBytes: UTF-8 byte length of the checked-in JSON file without compression.
methodology.pluralSuffixKeys: Lexical object-key suffix counts for keys ending in _zero/_one/_two/_few/_many/_other; this is a dictionary inventory, not a complete i18next plural-call analysis.
methodology.namespaceConstant: Extracted from exported NAMESPACES array in src/i18n/index.js; compared as names, not treated as a file manifest.
methodology.sourceHashes: SHA-256 of the named integration/source files, all files with scanned translation-hook or key-expression matches, and every locale JSON file.

startupRouteAudit.routeComponent: lazy Login page; Login calls useTranslation('auth')
startupRouteAudit.sharedBoundary: main.jsx wraps the app in Suspense with BootFallback; BootFallback only renders LoadingSpinner, whose accessible label is hard-coded 'Loading'.

providers.ThemeProvider: theme state only; no translation hooks
providers.BrandingProvider: public branding API and document title/favicon; no translation hooks
providers.AuthProvider: auth status fetch/state; no translation hooks
providers.OperationsProvider: operations API/poller gated by isAdmin; no translation hooks; it is gated off for auth-enabled unauthenticated login, while no-auth mode can start it briefly before Login redirects to /app

startupRouteAudit.errorSemantics: Do not discard the i18next initialization and backend error paths or providers' existing auth/API behavior when defining a candidate; BootFallback is the current suspense UI.
startupRouteAudit.nativeControlProposal: Keep every catalog, fallback, detector, backend, provider, and auth/error path. For an /login or /invite route, native i18next can optionally call loadNamespaces('auth') as soon as initialization is available, in parallel with existing initial namespaces and Login's lazy chunk; compare against existing lazy useTranslation('auth') and retain all load failures/fallback semantics. This is a route preload control, not key pruning.
